text: 1. One original copy and one photocopy of Application Form of Liaoning Provincial Government Scholarship for International Students (see the attachment)2. Notarized certificate of highest degree and transcripts. A certificate of enrollment or a certificate of employment should also be submitted if applicants have been officially employed for a job. Documents that are formulated neither in Chinese of English should be enclosed with a notarized Chinese or English version upon submission.3. One original copy and photocopy of Foreigners Physical Examination Report4. Study and Research Plan in China (no less than 1000 words)5. Recommendation letters from 2 professors or associate professors of the previous school.
